title: Pest Control Software Cost 2026: Real Prices Compared
description: How much pest control software costs: published prices for GorillaDesk, Jobber and Housecall Pro, yearly cost for solo operators, and which vendors are quote-only.
h1: How much does pest control software cost?
body:
Short answer: published prices for pest control software start at $29/mo and run to a few hundred dollars a month for small teams, while the pest-specific enterprise platforms (FieldRoutes, PestPac) don't publish prices at all. Every figure below is the vendor's own list price, re-checked on 2026-10-31 (GorillaDesk, Housecall Pro, FieldRoutes, PestPac; Jobber verified the same day for our Jobber pricing page). Prices exclude tax, card processing and add-ons. For features and our picks, see best pest control software and the pest control hub.

What a solo pest operator pays per year (list prices)

  • Jobber Core: $348/yr billed annually ($29 × 12) or $588/yr monthly ($49 × 12). Its pricing page doesn't list chemical or device tracking. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}
  • GorillaDesk Basic: $588/yr ($49 × 12, 1 route), including material tracking and reporting for chemical use records. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk plans}}
  • Housecall Pro Basic: $708/yr billed annually ($59 × 12) or $948/yr monthly ($79 × 12). {{aff:housecallpro|See Housecall Pro plans}}
  • GorillaDesk Pro: $1,188/yr ($99 × 12, 1 route), adding device tracking and barcoding plus QuickBooks Online sync.

Cost as you add routes or technicians

GorillaDesk charges per route, not per user. Its pricing page lists these monthly totals: 3 routes cost $149 (Basic), $199 (Pro) or $299 (Growth); 5 routes cost $209, $299 or $399. Jobber and Housecall Pro charge by user instead: Jobber adds $29/mo per extra user, while Housecall Pro includes 5 users on Essentials and 8 on MAX ($35/mo per extra user on MAX). For a side-by-side of headcount effects, see field service software cost for 1 vs 5 users.

FieldRoutes and PestPac: quote only

The two best-known pest-specific platforms don't publish prices. FieldRoutes' pricing page lists plans with a "Request Pricing" button, and PestPac's pricing page asks you to speak with a consultant to build a package. Budget for a sales demo and ask for any onboarding or setup fees in writing.

Costs on top of the subscription

  • Card processing: Jobber lists 2.9% + 30¢ online; Housecall Pro lists from 2.59%; GorillaDesk uses Stripe or Square at their rates.
  • Texting: GorillaDesk SMS is $5/mo plus message credit packs.
  • Data migration: free at GorillaDesk; not published for the others (unknown).
